name: squeeze_floor_binding_clamp
description: AC-1: para_armed squeeze collapses the stop distance below the floor; the floor clamps it back UP (its whole reason for existing). Catches an impl that never applies the floor, or applies it outside the squeeze branch.
derivation: safe_vol=0.30. raw=0.30*1.0=0.30. pre_squeeze=max(0.30,0.10)=0.30. para_armed -> active=0.30*0.5=0.15. squeeze_floor=0.20 is positive+finite and 0.20 <= pre_squeeze 0.30, so clamp = max(0.15, min(0.20,0.30)) = max(0.15,0.20) = 0.20. The floor BINDS: it lifts the collapsed 0.15 back up to 0.20. Output 0.20.
